t: This is the fountain at St Bartholomew's Hospital. It was designed by Philip Charles Hardwick, an English architect. There is little more to say about the fountain itself, but it is worth pausing here for a moment. Hardwick is the person credited with its design, so this small feature carries his name. Take a look at the details of the stonework and the water, and enjoy a quiet spot within the busy grounds of one of London's best-known hospitals.
